thread:
alex_s: Heads-up — we've got a customer (org redacted) saying free/promo credits were consumed after they downgraded yesterday. They report dashboard shows ~120 free credits left but invoice charged tokens that would have used those credits first. They provided a CSV of recent usage and a billing snapshot. Repro steps attached by customer.

priya_billing: Thanks — can you paste the invoice id and the org id? I want to pull the ledger entries. Also which promo id?

alex_s: Invoice `inv_01G9XYZ` and org `org-REDACTED-42`. Promo is `FREE100_Q4` (applied Nov 3). Customer says they downgraded plan at 2024-11-15T18:12Z.

miguel_eng: Do we have any known race between plan change and credit burn ordering? Last time we saw a race it was between the chargeable-token job and promo-ledger reconciliation.

clara_cs: Customer included a quick repro: 1) downgrade 2) hit embeddings endpoint heavily (multiple simultaneous requests) 3) see dashboard free balance unchanged, then invoice shows token charges. They captured request ids: `r_abc123`, `r_def456`, `r_ghi789`.

julie_support: Can someone from infra grep logs for those request ids? Also need the billing events around 2024-11-15T18:12:00 — 18:20:00. I suspect delayed free-pool assignment on the reservation service.

sam_ops: I'll pull the request traces and the billing ledger. Quick note: there was a small deployment to the billing worker at 2024-11-15T17:58Z (deploy_bot shows it). Could be related.

deploy_bot: deploy: billing-worker v2.14.1 promoted to prod at 2024-11-15T17:58:07 by ci/cd-pipeline. Changes: batch flush optimization for heavy workloads.

miguel_eng: That flush optimization touched the order of operations in the `consume_credits()` path. If a request arrives during a policy-change window (plan downgrade), the worker might mark tokens as billable before the free-credit reconciliation completes.

priya_billing: If that's true we need to identify all affected invoices. For this org, can you share the ledger rows? I want to see the sequence: promo debit, token charge, invoice line items.

alex_s: Customer sent CSV. Sample rows:
```
2024-11-15T18:12:05, r_abc123, embeddings, tokens: 243, billed: true, used_free_credit: false
2024-11-15T18:12:06, r_def456, embeddings, tokens: 310, billed: true, used_free_credit: false
2024-11-15T18:12:12, r_ghi789, embeddings, tokens: 98, billed: true, used_free_credit: false
```
They say dashboard shows free credits unchanged at 120 after those requests.

sam_ops: Pulled request traces. I see `r_abc123` went to node-gpu-03 and billing-worker processed it at 18:12:05. Ledger show token-charge event before promo-debit event for that minute — ordering looks inverted.

miguel_eng: Can you paste the exact worker logs around that time (sanitized)? Even a short tail of the relevant component helps.

sam_ops: Pasted sanitized tail:
```
[18:12:04] billing-worker: starting processing r_abc123
[18:12:05] billing-worker: charge_tokens org=org-REDACTED-42 tokens=243 request_id=r_abc123
[18:12:05] promo-reconciler: scheduled debit for promo=FREE100_Q4 org=org-REDACTED-42 at 18:12:06 (async)
[18:12:06] billing-worker: charge_tokens org=org-REDACT456 tokens=310 request_id=r_def456
[18:12:06] promo-reconciler: applied debit for promo=FREE100_Q4 amount=243 org=org-REDACTED-42
```
Note: there's a typo in one log line showing `org-REDACT456` (truncated) but IDs line up for r_abc123 and r_def456.

priya_billing: That ordering would cause tokens to be billed first, then promo debit applies, but invoice generation may already have snapshot before the debit. If invoice snapshot occurred between charge and debit, customer sees charge on invoice and dashboard eventually shows promo consumed (so counts differ).

clara_cs: Customer is upset because they explicitly timed the downgrade and expected credits to cover the next 5k tokens. They're asking for refund or credit adjustment.

julie_support: Short-term: offer a manual credit adjustment for the tokens billed that should have been covered. Long-term: we need an engineering fix to ensure atomicity or correct ordering when plan changes and heavy concurrent requests happen.

miguel_eng: Proposed fix: make promo-reconciler synchronous for plan-change windows OR update billing-worker to check promo-available cache before finalizing charge (optimistic locking). I'll open a small PR and link it here.

sam_ops: Also add a reconciliation job to backfill any ledger rows where `charge_tokens` precedes `promo_debit` within a 2-minute window of a plan-change event. We can auto-correct most cases.

priya_billing: Please also add a filter to find invoices generated between 17:57 and 18:22 UTC on 2024-11-15 for last 24-hour deploy — we need to proactively contact customers.

alex_s: I'll reply to the customer: we can refund affected tokens immediately and we'll follow up with root cause and a timeline for the fix.

clara_cs: Add a note for CS playbook: when downgrade happens, flag org for 10 minutes of extended reconciliation.

miguel_eng: PR created: https://git.internal/repo/billing/compare/PR-345 — changes to `consume_credits()` and added optimistic promo cache check. Request review from @sam_ops @priya_billing.

julie_support: Thanks everyone. Action items:
- sam_ops: run ledger backfill and produce list of affected invoices (ETA 6h)
- miguel_eng: small PR + test (ETA 24h)
- priya_billing: prepare outreach template and refund procedure (ETA 4h)
- alex_s/clara_cs: communicate to customer (now)

alex_s: I'll send the customer a provisional credit and follow-up note. :thumbsup:

priya_billing: Please cc me on the customer thread.

sam_ops: Backfill started — running against `ledger-prod` in dry-run now. Will post results when done.

deploy_bot: alert: billing-worker v2.14.1 flagged in post-deploy monitoring for increased token-latency variance (Nov 15 18:00–19:00).

miguel_eng: Noted, will prioritize a fix path that keeps latency improvements but fixes ordering.

julie_support: Closing the thread for now; reopen if new manifests or more affected accounts found.
